philippines.title: Midnight blaze hits Mabolo warehouse; damage reaches P1.4M
philippines.description:
CEBU CITY, Philippines — A fire broke out shortly after midnight on Wednesday, gutting a hardware warehouse along St. Jude Street in Barangay Mabolo, Cebu City. Fire authorities estimated the damage caused by the fire at P1.4 million. Ronieglen Lopez, a 20-year-old mechanic at the warehouse, said he noticed smoke coming from inside the building at around 11 p.m. on Tuesday, August 25. philippines.title: Ligutan tells defense: Post not for you, but for law students, public
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Counsel for the prosecution Amando Virgil Ligutan has countered the defense panel’s criticism of his Facebook post about misleading questions not being allowed even during cross-examination, noting that the statement was not issued for them, but for law students and the general public. In his counter-manifestation on Wednesday, at the start of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, Ligutan said nothing in his post was personal, noting that he intended to clarify to the public that misleading questions are not allowed.
